meaning:
might, strong, mighty
Aramaic of taq.qiph (תַּקִּיף "mighty" H8623)

elsewhere.note: There have also been mighty kings over Jerusalem, who have ruled over all the country beyond the River; and tribute, custom, and toll, was paid to them.
The fourth kingdom will be strong as iron, because iron breaks in pieces and subdues all things; and as iron that crushes all these, it will break in pieces…
